_comment: Утром заменить classes/aliases на виды повреждений из датасета организаторов. Код менять не нужно.
context: Photo from a city service vehicle camera, Moscow street. Assess the main (closest, most prominent) telecom infrastructure object: a cable well hatch or a utility pole with overhead cables.

object_question.instructions: Is a cable well (manhole cover, hatch, or an open/missing hatch opening), a utility pole or overhead cables visible and assessable in the photo?
object_question.true: Such an object is visible and its condition can be assessed.
object_question.false: No such object, or the photo is too blurry, dark, snowy or occluded to assess it.

kind_question.instructions: Which kind of object is the main one in the photo?

classes.cable_well: A hatch / manhole cover / cable well in the road or sidewalk.
classes.dual_pole: A utility pole, lighting pole or overhead cables.

defect_question.instructions: What is the condition of the main infrastructure object in the photo?

none.label: Объекта нет
none.description: There is no manhole cover, hatch, utility pole or overhead cable to assess in the photo.

ok.label: Норма
ok.description: Object looks intact, nothing to report.

open_hatch.label: Открытый люк
open_hatch.description: Hatch is open, displaced or missing; an opening is visible.

broken_cover.label: Повреждена крышка
broken_cover.description: Cover is cracked, broken or partially collapsed.

subsidence.label: Просадка
subsidence.description: Road surface around the hatch has sunk, cracked or there is a height step.

paved_over.label: Закатан в асфальт
paved_over.description: Hatch is covered by asphalt or debris and is not accessible.

pole_tilt.label: Наклон опоры
pole_tilt.description: Pole is visibly tilted, fallen or structurally damaged.

cable_sag.label: Провис кабеля
cable_sag.description: Cable hangs too low, is tangled or detached.

severity_question.instructions: How dangerous is the condition for pedestrians and traffic right now?

levels.description: Minor, can wait for planned maintenance.
Noticeable, should be fixed within days.
Critical: immediate threat to life or vehicles.

thresholds._comment: object_min: если модель склоняется к норме, а объект виден хуже порога — кадр 'не наблюдается' (дефекты этот порог не гасит). auto_ok: норма увереннее — подтверждается без человека. critical_prob: P(последний уровень опасности) выше — тревога в обход очереди. high_score: ожидаемый уровень опасности выше — severity high.
